An election to [[Reading Borough Council]] took place as of 5 May 2022. Following boundary changes all the seats on the council were up for election.<ref>{{cite web | url = https://www.lgbce.org.uk/media/new-political-map-for-reading-borough-council | title = New political map for Reading Borough Council | date = 2020-09-29 | website = [[Local Government Boundary Commission for England]] | access-date = 2021-02-05 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20210205090306/https://www.lgbce.org.uk/media/new-political-map-for-reading-borough-council | archive-date = 2021-02-05}}</ref>
